name: Yantarnoye leto
source:
This story features humor, romance, and a cozy vibe. Even though it is primarily about the red-haired pioneer girl, fans of the other girls will also find something to enjoy.

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1823649910]Steam[/url]]
translation:
这个故事充满幽默、浪漫和温馨的氛围。尽管它主要是关于红发先锋女孩的，但其他女孩的粉丝也会找到一些喜欢的东西。

[译自[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1823649910]Steam[/url]]
